Sandbox_EatSmart_NeedNutritionist_toolti: When enabled, calorie and protein options don't show up if you don't have the Nutritionist trait.
UI_EatSmart_goalCalories1Enable_tooltip: Adds an option to eat just enough food to reach your custom Calories value, if possible. <LINE>If the goal is already met or the selected food is not enough, the option will be disabled.
UI_EatSmart_goalCalories1Value_tooltip: Custom Calories value to reach, if possible.
UI_EatSmart_goalCaloriesMaxEnable_toolti: Adds an option to eat enough food to reach the maximum Calories value the character can have: 3700 Calories.
UI_EatSmart_goalCaloriesToGainWeightEnab: Adds an option to eat enough food to reach the Calories threshold where the character starts gaining weight. <LINE>This threshold depends on weight and metabolism traits. <LINE>The option intentionally consumes 5 extra Calories so the weight-gain arrows can appear briefly in the character info panel.
UI_EatSmart_goalHunger0Enable_tooltip: Adds an option to eat just enough food to reach 0⁒ Hunger, if possible. <LINE>If the goal is already met or the selected food is not enough, the option will be disabled.
UI_EatSmart_goalHunger1Enable_tooltip: Adds an option to eat just enough food to reach your custom Hunger value, if possible. <LINE>If the goal is already met or the selected food is not enough, the option will be disabled. <LINE>0⁒ means not hungry, 100⁒ means starving. <LINE>Vanilla Hunger moodle levels start around 15⁒, 25⁒, 45⁒, and 70⁒ hunger.
UI_EatSmart_goalHunger1Value_tooltip: Custom Hunger value to reach, if possible.
UI_EatSmart_goalProteins1Enable_tooltip: Adds an option to eat just enough food to reach your custom Proteins value, if possible. <LINE>If the goal is already met or the selected food is not enough, the option will be disabled. <LINE>Vanilla Strength XP gains a x1.5 multiplier when Proteins are above 50 and below 300. <LINE>Vanilla Strength XP gets a x0.7 multiplier when Proteins are below -300.
UI_EatSmart_goalProteins1Value_tooltip: Custom Proteins value to reach, if possible.
UI_EatSmart_goalThirst0Enable_tooltip: Adds an option to consume just enough food to reach 0⁒ Thirst, if possible. <LINE>If the goal is already met or the selected food is not enough, the option will be disabled.
